credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/apple.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: LOOMING: an S-twisted gnarled trunk, a wide low crown hunched over the foe, the lead bough sagging with apples, white blossom on top. Intro: an apple hangs at the crown's edge, lets go, drops and bounces once at the roots, where it rests. Crystal rule: crimson is the dark slot (fruit, bark and crown shade), leaf green the light, the blossom the shared white. Sport: Malus 'Royalty' (purple-leaved crabapple).
